summary: Robin Energy Ltd. filed a Form 6-K attaching an Exhibit 99.1 press release announcing results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting held September 10, 2026, in Limassol, Cyprus. Shareholders re-elected Mr. John Paul Syriopoulos as Class A Director until the 2029 AGM and appointed Deloitte Certified Public Accountants S.A. as independent auditors for fiscal 2026. This is a routine foreign-private-issuer meeting-results disclosure, not a special situation; no transaction terms, board recommendation on a deal, advisors, or structural mechanics are present. Watch for ordinary governance or auditor developments; no risk-arb angle.
